en.name: International Freight Forwarding
en.strap: Air and ocean freight, with the handovers connected.
en.intro: Plan the international leg together with pickup, documentation and destination delivery. We review cargo acceptance, trade terms and the points where responsibility changes.
en.scope: Routing and carrier options, FCL/LCL or air cargo, booking coordination, commercial documents and onward transport within the agreed scope.
en.process: Review the cargo and Incoterm, compare workable routes, confirm provider acceptance, then align booking, documentation and delivery milestones.
en.audience: For importers, exporters and procurement teams comparing the full shipment scope.
en.proof: The offer identifies the route, charging basis, inclusions, exclusions and handover responsibilities.

id.name: International Freight Forwarding
id.strap: Air dan ocean freight, dengan handover yang terhubung.
id.intro: Rencanakan angkutan internasional bersama pickup, dokumentasi, dan delivery tujuan. Cargo acceptance, trade terms, serta perpindahan tanggung jawab diperiksa sejak awal.
id.scope: Pilihan rute dan carrier, FCL/LCL atau air cargo, koordinasi booking, dokumen komersial, serta transport lanjutan sesuai cakupan.
id.process: Tinjau barang dan Incoterm, bandingkan rute yang memungkinkan, pastikan acceptance provider, lalu selaraskan booking, dokumen, dan delivery.
id.audience: Untuk importir, eksportir, serta procurement yang membandingkan cakupan satu shipment secara utuh.
id.proof: Penawaran memperjelas rute, dasar perhitungan biaya, komponen yang termasuk, pengecualian, dan tanggung jawab handover.

en.name: Customs Brokerage
en.strap: Prepare the declaration around the actual commodity.
en.intro: Review product specifications and align the invoice, packing list and transport document before clearance coordination begins.
en.scope: Commodity and HS classification review, supporting-document readiness, permit interfaces and clearance coordination through authorised parties where required.
en.process: Establish the responsible importer/exporter and declarant, resolve document discrepancies, coordinate filing handovers and follow up release instructions.
en.audience: For businesses preparing an import or export clearance assignment.
en.proof: Classification and permit requirements follow the actual product, use, origin and applicable rules.

id.name: Customs Brokerage
id.intro: Tinjau spesifikasi produk dan cocokkan invoice, packing list, serta dokumen angkut sebelum koordinasi clearance.
id.scope: Review komoditas dan HS code, kesiapan dokumen pendukung, kebutuhan izin, serta koordinasi clearance melalui pihak berwenang bila diperlukan.
id.process: Pastikan importir/eksportir serta deklaran, selesaikan selisih dokumen, lalu koordinasikan handover pengajuan dan instruksi release.
id.audience: Untuk perusahaan yang menyiapkan penugasan clearance impor atau ekspor.
id.proof: Klasifikasi serta izin mengikuti produk, penggunaan, asal barang, dan aturan yang berlaku.

en.name: 3PL & Warehousing
en.strap: Storage, handling and fulfilment as one operating flow.
en.intro: Build a warehouse brief around SKU profile, stockholding and order patterns. Define how goods are received, stored, picked and dispatched before choosing capacity.
en.scope: Receiving, put-away, stock reporting, pick-and-pack, returns and dispatch, matched to confirmed site and partner capability.
en.process: Review inbound volumes and peak stock, agree location and inventory controls, then define order processing, handover evidence and exception handling.
en.audience: For businesses planning stock storage, fulfilment or a change in warehouse operating flow.
en.proof: Site suitability, handling capacity, reporting and SLA are assessed against the actual operating brief.

id.name: 3PL & Warehousing
id.strap: Storage, handling, dan fulfilment sebagai satu alur kerja.
id.intro: Susun kebutuhan gudang berdasarkan profil SKU, stok, dan pola pesanan. Tentukan receiving, penyimpanan, picking, serta dispatch sebelum memilih kapasitas.
id.scope: Receiving, put-away, laporan stok, pick-and-pack, retur, dan dispatch sesuai kemampuan lokasi serta mitra yang dikonfirmasi.
id.process: Tinjau volume inbound dan stok puncak, sepakati kontrol lokasi serta inventory, lalu tentukan pemrosesan order, bukti handover, dan penanganan pengecualian.
id.audience: Untuk perusahaan yang merencanakan storage, fulfilment, atau perubahan alur kerja gudang.
id.proof: Kesesuaian lokasi, kapasitas handling, laporan, dan SLA dinilai terhadap kebutuhan operasional yang sebenarnya.

en.name: Domestic Distribution
en.strap: Mode, capacity and access planned together.
en.intro: Match FTL, LTL, FCL, LCL or domestic air to the cargo and the receiving site. Loading method, delivery window and proof of delivery belong in the same plan.
en.scope: Pickup, transport, consolidation where relevant, site handover and delivery evidence within the agreed route and service scope.
en.process: Check packed dimensions and weights, access restrictions and receiving hours; compare mode options and confirm loading and unloading responsibilities.
en.audience: For domestic distribution teams moving production inputs, stock or equipment across Indonesia.
en.proof: Equipment, route coverage, acceptance and delivery terms are confirmed for the inquiry.

id.name: Domestic Distribution
id.strap: Moda, kapasitas, dan akses direncanakan bersamaan.
id.intro: Cocokkan FTL, LTL, FCL, LCL, atau udara domestik dengan barang serta lokasi penerimaan. Metode muat, jadwal bongkar, dan POD masuk dalam satu rencana.
id.scope: Pickup, transport, konsolidasi bila diperlukan, serah terima lokasi, dan bukti delivery sesuai rute serta cakupan yang disepakati.
id.process: Periksa dimensi dan berat kemasan, batasan akses, serta jam penerimaan; bandingkan moda dan pastikan tanggung jawab muat/bongkar.
id.audience: Untuk tim distribusi domestik yang mengirim bahan produksi, stok, atau equipment di Indonesia.
id.proof: Unit, cakupan rute, acceptance, serta ketentuan delivery dikonfirmasi sesuai inquiry.

en.name: Project Cargo
en.strap: Heavy and oversized movements, planned against the real constraints.
en.intro: Start with transport drawings, verified weights and centre of gravity. Assess the route, equipment and lifting interfaces before committing a movement method.
en.scope: Feasibility coordination for OOG, heavy-lift, breakbulk and multimodal cargo, including route and handling interfaces subject to technical validation.
en.process: Review cargo drawings, load distribution, lifting/lashing points and site access; coordinate surveys and provider review before defining responsibilities and the movement sequence.
en.audience: For industrial equipment and non-standard cargo needing a cargo-specific transport and handling study.
en.proof: Methods, permits and equipment configurations require engineering, survey and provider confirmation.

id.name: Project Cargo
id.strap: Muatan berat dan oversized, direncanakan menurut batasan lapangan.
id.intro: Mulai dengan transport drawing, berat terverifikasi, dan centre of gravity. Nilai rute, equipment, serta interface lifting sebelum menetapkan metode pengiriman.
id.scope: Koordinasi studi kelayakan OOG, heavy-lift, breakbulk, dan multimoda, termasuk rute serta handling sesuai validasi teknis.
id.process: Tinjau drawing, distribusi beban, titik lifting/lashing, serta akses; koordinasikan survei dan review provider sebelum menetapkan tanggung jawab serta urutan kerja.
id.audience: Untuk equipment industri dan kargo nonstandar yang membutuhkan studi angkutan serta handling khusus.
id.proof: Metode, izin, serta konfigurasi equipment memerlukan konfirmasi engineering, survei, dan provider.

en: Air Import
Prepare origin documents, air cargo release and onward delivery as one inbound plan.
Review gross and volumetric weight, MAWB/HAWB instructions where applicable, arrival handling and customs inputs.
vora-visual-68.webp
id: Air Import
Siapkan dokumen asal, release kargo udara, dan delivery sebagai satu rencana inbound.
Tinjau gross serta volumetric weight, instruksi MAWB/HAWB bila digunakan, handling kedatangan, dan data clearance.
vora-visual-68.webp

en: Sea Import
Plan release, local charges and inland delivery before the vessel arrives.
FCL and LCL have different terminal/CFS interfaces. Confirm B/L release, free-time terms and destination responsibilities.
vora-visual-67.webp
id: Sea Import
Rencanakan release, local charges, dan trucking sebelum kapal tiba.
FCL dan LCL punya interface terminal/CFS berbeda. Pastikan release B/L, ketentuan free time, serta tanggung jawab di tujuan.
vora-visual-67.webp

en: Air Export
Align cargo readiness, acceptance and documents with the flight cut-off.
Packaging, screening, chargeable weight, AWB instructions and destination scope are reviewed before handover.
vora-visual-68.webp
id: Air Export
Selaraskan kesiapan barang, acceptance, serta dokumen dengan cut-off penerbangan.
Kemasan, screening, chargeable weight, instruksi AWB, serta cakupan tujuan diperiksa sebelum handover.
vora-visual-68.webp

en: Sea Export
Bring equipment, stuffing and shipping instructions into one sailing plan.
Check FCL/LCL suitability, carrier acceptance, SI, VGM and cargo/document cut-offs against the ready date.
vora-visual-65.webp
id: Sea Export
Hubungkan equipment, stuffing, dan shipping instructions dalam satu rencana pelayaran.
Periksa kesesuaian FCL/LCL, acceptance pelayaran, SI, VGM, serta cut-off kargo/dokumen terhadap ready date.
vora-visual-65.webp

en: FTL · Full Truckload
Dedicated capacity for loads that need a direct vehicle allocation.
Body dimensions, payload, loading sequence, site access and receiving hours determine the workable truck arrangement.
vora-visual-66.webp
id: FTL · Full Truckload
Kapasitas khusus untuk muatan yang membutuhkan alokasi satu kendaraan.
Dimensi bak, payload, urutan muat, akses lokasi, dan jam penerimaan menentukan pengaturan truk yang bisa dijalankan.
vora-visual-66.webp

en: LTL · Less Than Truckload
Shared vehicle capacity for cargo suited to consolidation and repeated handling.
Compare weight/volume basis, packaging, stackability, consolidation schedule and final-delivery scope.
vora-visual-62.webp
id: LTL · Less Than Truckload
Kapasitas kendaraan gabungan untuk barang yang sesuai dengan konsolidasi dan beberapa kali handling.
Bandingkan dasar berat/volume, kemasan, stackability, jadwal konsolidasi, serta cakupan last-mile delivery.
vora-visual-62.webp

en: FCL · Full Container Load
Dedicated container space with the port and inland legs planned together.
Select equipment around usable capacity, payload, stuffing/stripping method and empty-return terms.
vora-visual-65.webp
id: FCL · Full Container Load
Ruang kontainer khusus dengan port leg serta angkutan darat yang saling terhubung.
Pilih equipment sesuai kapasitas pakai, payload, metode stuffing/stripping, serta ketentuan empty return.
vora-visual-65.webp

en: LCL · Less Than Container Load
Shared container capacity for smaller domestic sea shipments.
Review CBM/weight basis, minimum charges, CFS receiving, deconsolidation and final-mile responsibilities.
vora-visual-67.webp
id: LCL · Less Than Container Load
Kapasitas kontainer gabungan untuk muatan laut domestik yang lebih kecil.
Tinjau basis CBM/berat, minimum charge, receiving CFS, deconsolidation, serta tanggung jawab last mile.
vora-visual-67.webp

en: Domestic Air Freight
Domestic air cargo when the delivery window justifies the mode.
Confirm commodity acceptance, screening, chargeable weight, airport handover and pickup/delivery scope.
vora-visual-68.webp
id: Air Freight Domestik
Kargo udara domestik untuk kebutuhan tiba yang sesuai dengan pilihan moda.
Pastikan commodity acceptance, screening, chargeable weight, handover bandara, serta cakupan pickup/delivery.
vora-visual-68.webp
